description: A hypothesis is never treated as the research workflow; a cohort is the unit of progression through G0-D0-D1-D2-confirmation.

IDEAS.entry: distinct causal mechanisms with preregistration BEFORE D0 counts; include negative controls
IDEAS.exit: whole original family moves to G0

G0.entry: 7 existing DEV months only with QC and timestamp indivisibility
G0.exit: whole registered family moves into D0; unsafe or nonportable mechanisms go blocked, not silently substituted

D0.entry: measure all CASE/CONTROL/OTHER/MISSING without future outcomes
D0.exit: freeze shortlist and the ENTIRE original statistical family; D1 is executed ONCE for all registered members, not one-by-one
D0.if_insufficient: retain all prior rules/IDs, register new mechanism blocks for NEXT cohort; do not combine post-hoc multiple testing families

D1.entry: registered signs/endpoints, 10k noncircular moving block L5/3/10, complete BH family and all outcomes
D1.statistical_screen: positive preregistered sign, 90pct CI lower >0 and exploratory BH q<=0.10 over original complete family, all three MUST be met; this is NOT confirmation
D1.economic_screen: if actual fills and costs are identifiable: net expectation after stress >0, paired net portfolio increment >0 and preregistered robustness; if ambiguous block rather than invent
D1.exit: evaluate every D1 member together and label survivors by separate tracks; non-directional context NEVER becomes trading strategy just for positive range
D1.if_zero: close D1 cohort, do NOT force D2 nor reoptimize thresholds

D2.entry: do not deepen ONE lucky hypothesis: pool at least two distinct causal mechanisms with actual executable directional/economic path; other lone survivors remain parked
D2.require: one chronological account/router, stress costs, PF, DD, overlap and capacity; no lookahead or fictitious Last fills
D2.exit: joint D2 report and risk gate for ALL pooled survivors
D2.if_blocked: flag FAILED_EXECUTION/HOLD_FOR_BATCH rather than claim profitability

CONFIRMATION.entry: separate explicit OOS authorization, locked rules and Gate1/Holm/annual robustness
CONFIRMATION.exit: only after independently confirmed execution and funding constraints, never automatically
